task.description: Validate src/design/iss0184-c3-event-store-test-leak.md, a Type E design fixing ISS-0184 cluster C3: TC-ES-03-01 in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig leaks 3 heap allocations because neither `first.record` nor `second.record` (both AppendResult values from store.append() calls) is ever deinit()'d. Design specifies defer first.record.deinit(alloc) and defer second.record.deinit(alloc) placed immediately after each append() call. CODE-DESIGNER also swept the whole file and found ZERO existing .record.deinit() calls across all 34 store.append() call sites -- a file-wide gap, not unique to this test -- and intentionally scoped the design to fix only the 2 sites in TC-ES-03-01 (matching ISS-0184 C3's MINOR, single-block scope), flagging the other 32 as an explicit out-of-scope follow-up rather than silently expanding this run. Verify: (1) the defer placement is correct and matches EventRecord.deinit()'s actual signature/behavior (src/event_store/store.zig ~line 96-100); (2) confirm the 34-call-site / 0-existing-deinit claim yourself via grep, don't just trust it; (3) confirm the scope-boundary decision (fix 2, flag 32) is the right call given ISS-0184 C3's stated severity (MINOR) and disposition (DIRECT_FIX_CANDIDATE) -- or whether CLAUDE.md's Unblock-Everything directive should actually require fixing all 34 in this run (read that directive's exact wording on 'blocking vs. adjacent' scope boundary and apply it here: does a leak in 32 OTHER tests block THIS run's acceptance criteria, or is it a genuinely separate, filed-and-forwarded concern?); (4) no production code touched.
acceptance_criteria: defer placement verified correct against EventRecord.deinit()
Scope-boundary decision (fix 2, flag 32) evaluated against CLAUDE.md Unblock-Everything vs. scope boundary wording, with an explicit verdict
